title: I connettori: so, because, although, however, besides
rule: Causa: because + frase (ragione), because of + nome, since / as (dato che). Conseguenza: so + frase (quindi), therefore (formale), as a result. Contrasto in una frase: but, although / even though / though (benché, davanti alla subordinata); yet (ma, letterario). Fra due frasi: however (però, con virgola), nevertheless (ciononostante), on the other hand (d'altra parte). Aggiunta: and, also, besides (oltretutto), in addition, moreover (formale). Chiarificazione: in fact (anzi), actually (in realtà). Esempio: for example, for instance, such as. Chiusura: anyway (comunque), in short, to sum up, all in all. Regole: non because e so insieme; non although e but insieme; however e besides all'inizio di una nuova frase con la virgola.

head: Tipo
Connettore
Esempio
rows: causa (ragione)
because + frase · because of + nome · since / as (dato che)
I was late because the streetcar was slow. · Because of the snow, I was late. · Since you're here, let's eat.
conseguenza
so + frase · therefore (formale) · as a result
The streetcar was slow, so I was late. · The data were wrong; therefore, the result is invalid. · As a result, I was late.
contrasto in una frase
but · although · though · even though · yet (letterario)
I was tired, but I baked. · Although I was tired, I baked. · I was tired, though. · Even though it was cold, we walked.
contrasto fra frasi
However, · Nevertheless, · On the other hand,
I love Toronto. However, I miss the sea. · The job is hard. Nevertheless, I love it.
aggiunta
and · also · besides, · in addition, · moreover,
I'm tired. Besides, it's raining. · In addition, the forecast says snow.
chiarificazione
In fact, · Actually, · In other words,
I like it. In fact, I love it. · Actually, I was wrong.
esempio
For example, · For instance, · such as
Many Italian cities, for example Naples and Rome.
chiusura
Anyway, · In short, · All in all, · To sum up,
Anyway, I'll see you Sunday. · All in all, it was a good year.
sequenza
First, · Then · After that · Next · Finally
First, I got up. Then I made coffee. Finally, I left.

blocks.title: Un «ma» italiano, quattro «ma» inglesi
blocks.text: L'italiano usa [[ma]] per tutto; l'inglese divide. [[But]] dentro una frase ([[I was tired, but I baked]]). [[However]] all'inizio di una nuova frase, formale ([[I was tired. However, I baked]]). [[Although / even though]] davanti alla subordinata ([[Although I was tired, I baked]]). [[Though]] alla fine, informale ([[I was tired, though]]). Non usarli insieme: [[although… but]] è l'errore italiano numero uno con i connettori.

items.t: I love Toronto because the people are kind and the pizza is bad. However, I miss the sea. Besides, I miss Dora's cooking.
items.n: Amo Toronto perché la gente è gentile e la pizza è pessima. Però mi manca il mare. Oltretutto mi manca la cucina di Dora.

items.t: The streetcar was slow, so I was late. Although I ran, I didn't make it on time. Anyway, Priya didn't notice.
items.n: Il tram era lento, quindi ho fatto tardi. Benché abbia corso, non ce l'ho fatta in tempo. Comunque, Priya non ha notato.

items.t: Winters are long. On the other hand, summers are beautiful. In short, Toronto is a city of extremes.
items.n: Gli inverni sono lunghi. D'altra parte, le estati sono bellissime. In breve, Toronto è una città di estremi.

items.t: First, I got up. Then I made coffee. Next, I ran to the bakery. Finally, I remembered I had the day off.
items.n: Prima mi sono alzata. Poi ho fatto il caffè. Poi sono corsa in panetteria. Alla fine mi sono ricordata che avevo il giorno libero.

items.wrong: Because I was tired, so I baked.
items.right: I was tired, so I baked. / Because I was tired, I baked.

items.wrong: Although I was tired, but I baked.
items.right: Although I was tired, I baked.
I'm tired. However, I'll come. / Although I'm tired, I'll come.
items.why: However introduce una nuova frase, con virgola.

items.wrong: Besides I'm tired, it's raining. (fuori dalla frase)
items.why: Besides all'inizio di una nuova frase.

items.right: Because it was late. / Because of the time.

items.q: I was late ___ (because / so) the streetcar was slow, ___ (because / so) I ran. ___ (although / however) I ran, I was late. Priya didn't say anything, ___ (though / although).
items.n: Ero in ritardo perché il tram era lento, quindi ho corso. Benché abbia corso, ero in ritardo. Priya non ha detto niente, però.

items.q: «Però mi manca il mare.» (new sentence after "I love Toronto")
options: But however I miss the sea.
items.why: However, all'inizio di nuova frase, con virgola.

items.q: I'm tired. Besides, it's late. Anyway, I'll come.
answers: I'm tired. Besides, it's late. Anyway, I'll come
